title: poa secunda var. stenophylla
intro: Poa secunda var. stenophylla, commonly known as Sandberg's bluegrass, is a perennial grass native to the western United States. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Poa secunda var. stenophylla include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
